prompt: Eight students reported how many hours they worked last week: $3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 14, 18$. What is the interquartile range (IQR)?
hint: Split the ordered list into a lower half and an upper half. $Q_1$ is the median of the lower half, $Q_3$ the median of the upper half.

hints.text: Split the ordered list into a lower half and an upper half. $Q_1$ is the median of the lower half, $Q_3$ the median of the upper half.
Lower half $3, 5, 7, 8$ has median $\frac{5 + 7}{2} = 6$. Upper half $10, 12, 14, 18$ has median $\frac{12 + 14}{2} = 13$.

explanation: With eight values, the lower half is $3, 5, 7, 8$ and the upper half is $10, 12, 14, 18$.
IQR $= 13 - 6 = 7$: the middle half of the students span $7$ hours.

alternativeExplanations.title: Quartiles as 25th and 75th percentiles
steps: A quarter of the data (2 values) sits below $Q_1$, so $Q_1$ is between the 2nd and 3rd values: between 5 and 7, which is 6.
A quarter sits above $Q_3$, so $Q_3$ is between the 6th and 7th values: between 12 and 14, which is 13.
